projects.title: Projects
proj_fe_1_desc: Full-stack inventory management system: React and Zustand client, Express REST API with MongoDB and Swagger docs.
proj_fe_2_desc: Pizza menu and ordering app built with React, TypeScript, Vite, TanStack Query and Supabase.
proj_fe_3_desc: Mobile device repair and management app built with React, TypeScript and Tailwind.
proj_fe_4_desc: Team project (3 people) to learn by building: generates project ideas tailored to your stack and level, with step-by-step guides, tasks, hints and solutions. React, TypeScript, Zustand and TanStack Query frontend; Express API with Prisma, Zod and PostgreSQL.
proj_fe_5_desc: Baby product guides and comparisons, built 100% with Astro and Preact islands only where content is dynamic (side-by-side comparison, filters). Full reviews and buying guides for strollers, car seats, cribs, baby monitors and high chairs.
proj_fe_6_desc: Multi-tenant SaaS for phone, computer and console repair shops: work orders, QR tracking, technicians, inventory and invoicing. Java + Spring Boot API with hexagonal architecture (ports and adapters) and PostgreSQL, recurring subscription billing via Wompi, React frontend and an Astro landing animated with GSAP.
proj_fe_7_desc: Restaurant menu and card generator in PDF built with Next.js: choose a template, add dishes, optional QR and download a print-ready PDF.
proj_be_1_desc: E-commerce REST API with NestJS, TypeORM and PostgreSQL: JWT authentication, image uploads to Cloudinary and OpenAPI/Swagger docs.
proj_be_2_desc: Full-stack appointments system: React frontend with Redux Toolkit and Tailwind, Express REST API with PostgreSQL and JWT authentication with bcrypt.
proj_be_3_desc: REST backend with Java, Spring Boot and JWT authentication for the mobile repair system.
proj_be_4_desc: Deliverables system for BP Ventures consultancy: file management with hierarchies, invoicing and payments, companies module and notifications. API documented in OpenAPI/Swagger with CI (GitHub Actions) syncing it to SwaggerHub.
proj_dev_1_desc: Infrastructure as Code practice with Terraform — exercises from basic to advanced (Terratest), simulating AWS locally with Floci/LocalStack.
proj_dev_2_desc: Interactive platform to practice AWS architecture challenges: drag services onto a canvas (React Flow), connect them and a declarative evaluation returns a score and feedback. CloudFormation/Terraform parsing, Zustand state, Zod validation and Vitest tests.
proj_dev_3_desc: Multi-tenant serverless attendance and presence system (schools and workplaces): QR check-in, GPS validation in Lambda, DynamoDB single-table, SNS notifications and a dashboard on S3 + CloudFront. Infrastructure as Code with Terraform and CI/CD with GitHub Actions + OIDC.
